content:
[L] med | Rules table, actions column | Delete buttons for the two rows are vertically touching/overlapping with no gap between them.
[S] med | Rules table header | WHEN column header is not left-aligned with a consistent gutter — columns lack consistent rhythm between NAME/WHEN/THEN.
[H] low | Rules table rows | Warning strings "legacy trigger — never fires" and "(needs approval)" are debug-like raw system messages competing with user-facing row text.
[H] med | Pending approvals card | Label "rule #2 on conversation #2" exposes internal IDs/debug strings instead of human-readable entity names.
[H] low | Pending approvals card | "raw proposed action" disclosure reads as a debug term, not user-facing copy.
[C] high | Bottom half of screen | Entire lower two-thirds of the window is an unmanaged empty dead zone with only a floating footer line.
[S] med | Footer area | Footer caption floats centered in empty space with no container or visual anchoring.
[S] low | Header area | "New Rule" button is vertically centered against two lines of header text, misaligned with the title baseline.
[L] low | Rules card vs Pending approvals card | Pending approvals card is much narrower than the Rules card above, creating an inconsistent two-card composition.
[C] med | Table WHEN column | Warning icon + message crowds the trigger text with uneven internal spacing between rows.
TOTAL 10
